artworks.title: Barthe
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man. He is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right, with curly hair, a round face, full cheeks, and a calm expression. The man wears a formal double-breasted suit with a high-collared white shirt and a cravat, and there is a signature below the portrait that reads "Barthe."

artworks.title: The Greasy Pole
artworks.medium: lithograph (colored with stencils?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a satirical scene involving figures climbing a pole to reach rewards. A tall vertical pole is depicted with three figures positioned at different heights as they climb towards a canopy of hanging items including sashes, a bishop's mitre, and medals. At the top of the pole, a few banners are displayed with inscribed dates and words. Each climber exhibits unique attire, hinting at different professions or roles. The canopy from which the objects hang is labeled "Ministère". The scene is set against a plain background with the name "Le Mât de Cocagne" inscribed below. The drawing is finely inked and colored, focusing attention on the expressions and actions of the climbers.

artworks.title: Lithographic Workshop
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite with brown wash heightened with white goauche on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (diameter): 13.7 cm (5 3/8 in.)
sheet: 17.3 x 22.5 cm (6 13/16 x 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's studio with various sketches and annotations. The central circular scene depicts a detailed interior of a workshop with artistic activity. Shelves filled with books and items, easels, and various artistic tools on tables are visible. The walls are lined with shelves holding jars and supplies, and papers or cloths hang from strings across the room. Outside the circular scene, there are lightly sketched elements, lines, and notes.

artworks.title: Lithographic Workshop
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite with brown wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (diameter): 14 cm (5 1/2 in.)
sheet: 19.4 x 20.5 cm (7 5/8 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior workshop with various scenes depicting activities. The image shows a workspace with furniture, tools, and art supplies related to lithography. Figures are shown engaged in tasks at wooden tables within a round frame. A printing press is visible on the left. Shelves hold vases, and there is a pitched roof with illuminated framing. French writing appears at the top and bottom of the image. Additional sketches are outside the circular frame, contributing to the drawing's detailed and industrious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Arrival at an Inn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on light blue-green laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor street scene with figures in historical attire and horses. The scene depicts a group of individuals dressed in traditional clothing, with at least two of them mounted on horses. One horse carries an additional figure gesturing animatedly, and a small animal can be seen atop one of the figures. The setting features a building with arched windows and a stone entrance. A star symbol adorns a panel on the building. The group seems to be engaged in conversation or discussion.

artworks.title: Visitation
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals standing next to each other. The person on the left has long, wavy hair and wears a long, flowing garment in a light color with a robe over it. The individual on the right wears a headpiece and long, flowing robes in shades of blue and pink. Both figures have halos around their heads. They hold hands in front of a building with large columns and an arched doorway. The background shows a hilly landscape with trees and a distant structure.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Feather Design
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in black on hand-washed green paper
artworks.description: The image displays a repeating pattern of teardrop-shaped motifs on a green background. Each motif resembles a stylized paisley with decorative borders, arranged diagonally in a symmetrical manner.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in gold on hand-washed blue-green paper
artworks.description: The image shows diagonal, parallel lines intersected by horizontal shorter lines on a teal background. The design resembles elongated diamonds or parallelograms, similar to patterns found in textiles or wallpaper. Repeated golden elements add uniformity and rhythm to the composition, resembling a grid-like structure seen in contemporary abstract art.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in gold on tan paper
artworks.description: The image features small, irregular, mustard-colored marks diagonally arranged across the canvas. These shapes resemble scattered seeds or grains, distributed consistently and evenly across the surface. The overall composition evokes a sense of ordered randomness, similar to patterns found in natural formations like sand dunes or textured fabric.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in gold on hand-washed blue-green paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pattern of intersecting diagonal lines creating diamond shapes. Each diamond contains leaf-like motifs, suggesting vines or botanical structures. The teal background emphasizes the golden leaf designs.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in gold on blue-gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pattern of delicate lines and scattered golden shapes on a green background. The gold shapes resemble small flowers and leaves. These elements give the impression of movement like vines or tendrils. The contrast between the gold and green highlights the decorative pattern, similar to intricate wallpaper or a textile design.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in gold on hand-washed yellow paper
artworks.description: The image displays a large rectangular area with intricate patterns of small, abstract floral-like designs on a sandy background. The patterns resemble soft, dotted fabric texture or classic wallpaper designs. The motifs suggest scattered blossoms or leaves, hinting at natural, botanical forms.

artworks.title: Endpaper
artworks.medium: woodcut (?) in black on tan paper
artworks.description: The image shows irregular dotted lines forming an intricate and abstract pattern resembling paisley and floral motifs. Some formations curve and twist like elongated raindrops or teardrops, while others resemble small flower petals or snowflakes. The pattern is repetitive, creating a uniform and delicate balance between structure and fluidity.

artworks.title: Amida Buddha
artworks.medium: woodcut [fragment]
artworks.description: This print contains nine rows of a repeated print showing a seated figure. The figure appears to be sitting cross-legged with their hands in their lap on top of a mound of leaves or petals and surrounded by circular, halo-like lines. The figure appears to have their head in a knot on the top of their head and long ears. Each repeated version of the figure is different, with different areas where the ink is faint or has bled, as well as areas where the beige paper is ripped or discolored. The edges of the print appear to have been torn or ripped, with other rows of figures partially visible.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: engraving  [restrike, probably late 18th century impression]
artworks.description: The image is a fragmented print showing a full-length depiction of two figures. The central figure appears to be a person holding a child-like figure in their arms. The adult figure is standing upright, with both facing forward. Their facial features are simple and stylized, with defined outlines suggesting eyes and simple curved lines for mouths. The adult figure is wearing a garment that drapes over them, perhaps a robe with intricate detailing suggested by the lines on the garment. On their head, there seems to be a halo or headdress indicated by the circular line above it. The child figure is at their side, facing left, and appears to be wearing a similar style of garment with lines indicating folds. Surrounding the figures are ornate decorative elements, including floral or scroll-like designs. The background of the image includes these decorative motifs along with a border framing the entire composition. The bottom of the page includes faint hand-written text, "printed by S. L. Hartz," which appears to be in pencil. The print background is otherwise plain.

artworks.title: Monument to Nicolai Wanostrocht
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body statue of a figure in a contemplative pose, partially leaning against a stone plaque inscribed with text. The figure has curly hair, a focused facial expression, and is dressed in classical attire with draped robes and sandals. The statue is situated within an ornately decorated architectural niche with gothic-style arches and floral motifs. The background is a textured surface that accentuates the three-dimensional details of the statue and niche.

artworks.title: Rotterdam
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with a high horizon showing a sky meeting buildings and industrial structures, including a windmill. The art style is detailed with cross-hatching, creating a textured look. The color scheme is sepia, giving the image an atmospheric quality. A rowboat with a figure is seen on the water, surrounded by moored boats, leading to distant industrial outlines and wisps of smoke.

artworks.title: Mlle Moréno de la Comédie-Française
artworks.medium: color lithograph on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person's head and upper torso. The individual has their chin resting on their hands, which are placed close to the face. Facial features are softly drawn, with indistinct eyes and a gentle expression. The hair is dark, thick, and swathes around the head, blending into the background. The person appears to be wearing a nondescript top. The surrounding environment consists of soft, intertwined lines in a swirling pattern, with some plant-like elements in the background. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background features earthy and muted tones of red, brown, and purple.

artworks.title: The Seine, Paris
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image displays the Seine River with an arched stone bridge crossing from left to right. The low horizon line is defined by the bridge, above which is the Parisian cityscape with spires and domes. The etching showcases detailed hatching to depict depth and texture in the trees and water. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Boats float on the river with reflections. In the distance, city structures add depth. Skies above the city are lightly marked with cloud-like renderings.

artworks.title: Ship under Sail
artworks.medium: engraving and etching
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a sailing ship in the water, featuring detailed rigging and sails. The horizon is low, emphasizing the ship. The drawing also includes a rocky landscape with a castle or fort on a cliff in the distance. The background depicts mountains fading into the sky. Delicate lines define the ship and the shore. The color palette is monochromatic, using different shades of grey for contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Ships Fighting
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a naval scene depicted through detailed sketch. The viewpoint is from sea level, displaying ships and action on the water. A large ship with partially unfurled sails is in the center, surrounded by smoke indicating cannon fire. A smaller sailing vessel is on the right, while a partly sunken vessel is on the left. Rugged mountains are seen in the background. The artist's technique is intricate, using detailed line work common in etchings. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from light tones to dark lines, emphasizing the scene's intensity.

artworks.title: Shipwreck
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed ship anchored in calm waters. The horizon is low in the composition, with a wide sky dominating the upper half. The ship is slightly right of center, with a distant shore on the right with sparse palm trees. The brushstrokes create texture and depth, especially in the ship and water. The color palette is sepia and gray, emphasizing the etching technique.

artworks.title: Two Large Ships under Construction
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a shipyard with two large wooden ships under construction or repair. The viewpoint is elevated, offering a detailed look at the scene. The ships are the main focus, with a distant sailing ship on the left. The style features delicate and precise brushstrokes, creating realistic textures and rigging. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown. There are figures scattered across the vessels, depicting a busy atmosphere typical of a shipyard.

artworks.title: Mrs. Montague
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.medium: stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of Mrs. Montagu, focusing on her head and upper torso. She is sitting in profile, facing to the right side of the image. Her facial features are delicate, with a prominent nose and finely arched eyebrows, and her hair is styled in a sophisticated updo with a lace-trimmed cap or head covering. She is wearing an elegant dress with intricate lace details visible on the sleeves and front, complemented by a large bow at the neckline. A pair of earrings is visible as her only jewelry. The background features a softly textured curtain and possibly furniture.
